references.text: Judah steps forward as the spokesman for his brothers before Joseph, which explains why Jacob sends specifically Judah ahead to meet Joseph.
Israel (Jacob) decides to travel to Egypt to see Joseph before he dies – this is the background for why Jacob now sends Judah ahead.
Jacob and his entire family travel to Egypt after receiving God's assurances in a night vision.
Joseph introduces his father Jacob and his brothers to Pharaoh, and they are given the land of Goshen as their dwelling place – the goal of Judah's advance mission.
